entities.name: Loki Laufeyson
entities.summary: The God of Mischief from the Marvel Cinematic Universe who, after escaping with the Tesseract during the 2012 Time Heist in New York, is arrested by the Time Variance Authority (TVA). Partnering with Agent Mobius to track another variant, he questions his preordained villainous purpose and ultimately evolves to seek freedom and identity beyond the Sacred Timeline.

entities.name: Sylvie Laufeydottir
entities.summary: A female variant of Loki whose childhood timeline in Asgard was pruned by the TVA under Judge Renslayer. After escaping custody with a stolen TemPad, Sylvie spent centuries hiding across catastrophic apocalypses where timeline variance goes undetected. She possesses powerful mind-enchantment magic and is driven by an unyielding quest to destroy the Time-Keepers and dismantle the TVA.

entities.name: Mobius M. Mobius
entities.summary: A veteran analyst for the Time Variance Authority specializing in dangerous temporal criminals. Known for his calm demeanor, fondness for mid-20th-century aesthetics, and passion for 1990s jet skis, Mobius recruits Variant Loki to track Sylvie. He eventually discovers that all TVA staff are brainwashed human variants kidnapped from pruned timelines.

entities.name: Ravonna Renslayer
entities.summary: A high-ranking Judge within the Time Variance Authority who previously served as Hunter A-20. Renslayer personally arrested young Sylvie in Asgard and maintains direct access to the Time-Keepers. Unwaveringly dedicated to the preservation of the Sacred Timeline, she seeks free will and ultimate order even after learning the Time-Keepers are mindless androids.

entities.name: Hunter B-15
entities.summary: A formidable and physically imposing Minuteman commander who arrests Loki in the Gobi Desert. During the Roxxcart ambush, Sylvie enchants B-15, temporarily restoring memories of her past happy human life on Earth. Shattered by this revelation, B-15 turns against Judge Renslayer and allies with Mobius to expose the TVA's foundational deception.

entities.name: He Who Remains
entities.summary: A brilliant 31st-century scientist variant who discovered the existence of alternate universes. When his more ruthless variants engaged in a devastating Multiversal War for universal dominion, he harnessed the trans-temporal entity Alioth to end the conflict and isolate reality into the Sacred Timeline, establishing the TVA to prune any divergent branch.

metadata.location: Citadel at the End of Time
metadata.power: TemPad Mastery / Omniscience within Sacred Timeline

entities.name: Miss Minutes
entities.summary: An artificial intelligence taking the visual form of an animated orange anthropomorphic clock with a Southern drawl. Created by He Who Remains, Miss Minutes serves as the welcoming orientation guide and administrative core of the TVA, while secretly operating as He Who Remains' direct emissary.

entities.name: Classic Loki
entities.summary: An elderly variant of Loki who survived his confrontation with Thanos in Avengers: Infinity War by conjuring an illusion so convincing that even the Mad Titan believed it. He drifted to an isolated planet where he lived in loneliness for centuries until deciding to find his brother Thor, which immediately triggered a Nexus Event and led to his pruning into The Void.

entities.name: Kid Loki
entities.summary: A young boy variant of Loki who commands immense respect among the variants in The Void because his Nexus Event was killing his brother Thor. He carries a golden curved dagger and maintains a makeshift underground palace in a ruined bowling alley.

entities.name: Alligator Loki
entities.summary: A reptilian Loki variant in the form of an alligator wearing a miniature golden horned helmet. Pruned by the TVA for eating the wrong neighbor's cat, Alligator Loki communicates in growls and bites, famously severing President Loki's right hand in a brawl.

entities.name: Casey
entities.summary: An earnest TVA office clerk working in evidence and logistics. Unaware of life outside the TVA, Casey famously keeps drawers filled with confiscated Infinity Stones, using them as paperweights because magic and cosmic artifacts have no power within the TVA's null-time nullification field.

entities.name: Time Variance Authority
entities.summary: A vast bureaucratic organization operating in the Null-Time Zone outside space and time. Built ostensibly to enforce the decrees of the Time-Keepers and protect the Sacred Timeline, the TVA arrests temporal variants and prunes divergent branch timelines using Reset Charges.

entities.name: Alioth
entities.summary: A massive, trans-temporal living storm resembling a colossal cloud with a purple canine skull. Alioth was born from the dimensional rifts of the Multiversal War and consumes all time and matter dumped into The Void. He Who Remains harnessed Alioth to wipe out his variant enemies and guard the Citadel.

entities.name: The Time-Keepers
entities.summary: Three colossal, godlike beings revered by the TVA as the cosmic architects who united the multiverse into the Sacred Timeline. When Sylvie infiltrates their inner sanctum and decapitates the central figure, they are exposed as mindless animatronic androids puppeted by He Who Remains.

entities.name: Citadel at the End of Time
entities.summary: A mysterious gothic castle carved from black stone and gold veins perched on an asteroid at the extreme end of the temporal stream, encircled by the glowing ring of the Sacred Timeline. It serves as the secluded residence and control room of He Who Remains.

metadata.architecture: Kintsugi / Black Stone with Gold Veins

events.name: Loki's Arrest in the Gobi Desert
events.description: Following the Avengers' 2012 New York time-travel mishap, Loki seizes the dropped Tesseract and teleports to the Gobi Desert in Mongolia. Hunter B-15 and Minutemen step through a timedoor, subdue him with a Time Baton operating at 1/16th speed, retrieve the Tesseract, and deploy a Reset Charge.
consequences: Loki brought to TVA for processing

events.name: Mobius Interrogates Loki in Time Theater 25
events.description: Agent Mobius saves Loki from immediate pruning and brings him to Time Theater 25. Mobius projects holographic playback of Loki's past and future canon, including his role in Frigga's death, Odin's peace, and his demise at the hands of Thanos, shattering Loki's belief in his glorious purpose.
consequences: Loki accepts reality of his death

events.name: Loki Discovers Infinity Stones as Paperweights
events.description: After escaping the Time Theater, Loki threatens desk clerk Casey to recover the Tesseract. Casey opens his desk drawer revealing dozens of Infinity Stones confiscated from variants, explaining employees use them as paperweights because cosmic stones hold no power in the TVA.
consequences: Loki realizes the TVA is the greatest power in the universe

events.name: Testing the Apocalypse Theory in Pompeii
events.description: Loki deduces that the rogue variant is hiding inside natural apocalypses where imminent total destruction prevents any action from altering future outcomes. To prove this, Mobius and Loki visit Pompeii in 79 AD moments before Mount Vesuvius erupts; Loki speaks Latin and releases livestock without causing a Nexus Event.
consequences: TVA begins searching apocalyptic historical windows

events.name: Bombing of the Sacred Timeline at Roxxcart
events.description: The TVA tracks Sylvie to a Roxxcart superstore in Haven Hills, Alabama, during a 2050 hurricane. Sylvie enchants Hunter B-15 and shop patrons, confronts Loki, and reveals a synchronized array of stolen reset charges that she teleports across historical eras, causing the Sacred Timeline to branch uncontrollably.

events.name: Stranded on Lamentis-1
events.description: After brawling at the TVA, Loki uses Sylvie's TemPad to escape, landing them on the mining moon Lamentis-1 in 2077 during an extinction-level planetary collision. The TemPad's power cell is drained, forcing the two rival variants to sneak onto an evacuation Ark.
consequences: Loki and Sylvie forced into reluctant partnership

events.name: Nexus Event Spike on Lamentis-1
events.description: Facing unavoidable death as the meteor strikes destroy the evacuation Ark, Loki and Sylvie sit together and hold hands. The profound emotional bond between two variants of the same being creates an unprecedented vertical branching Nexus spike that bypasses the apocalypse suppression, allowing the TVA to pinpoint and rescue them.
consequences: TVA detects and extracts them seconds before impact

events.name: Unmasking the Android Time-Keepers
events.description: Judge Renslayer brings Loki and Sylvie to the golden chamber to be executed before the Time-Keepers. Hunter B-15 frees them, sparking a battle. Sylvie throws her blade and decapitates the central Time-Keeper, only for its head to spark with robotic wiring. Renslayer then prunes Loki from behind.

events.name: Arrival in The Void and Variant Encounter
events.description: Loki awakens in a grassy wasteland beneath a roiling storm cloud and is greeted by Classic Loki, Kid Loki, Alligator Loki, and Boastful Loki. They inform him that everything pruned by the TVA is sent to this Void at the end of time to be devoured by Alioth.
consequences: Loki learns of Alioth and the true nature of pruning

events.name: Enchanting Alioth and Classic Loki's Sacrifice
events.description: To breach the storm guarding the master of the timeline, Classic Loki conjures a breathtaking, full-scale glowing illusion of Asgard to distract Alioth. Screaming 'Glorious purpose!', Classic Loki is consumed, giving Loki and Sylvie the focus needed to combine their magic and enchant Alioth, opening the pathway to the Citadel.
consequences: Citadel at the End of Time revealed

events.name: Assassination of He Who Remains and Multiverse Unleashed
events.description: Inside the Citadel, He Who Remains presents a choice: kill him and spark a multiversal war with his variants, or take over running the TVA. Sylvie attacks while Loki fights to stop her. After kissing Loki, Sylvie hurls him through a TemPad portal to the TVA and kills He Who Remains, causing infinite multiverse branches to redline.
events.location: Citadel at the End of Time

events.name: Loki Discovers the Rewritten TVA
events.description: Loki runs through TVA headquarters to find Mobius and Hunter B-15 to warn them about the Kang variants. Mobius looks at him blankly and asks 'Who are you? What division are you from?' Looking into the atrium, Loki sees that the statues of the Time-Keepers have been replaced by a towering monument to He Who Remains.
consequences: Mobius and B-15 have no memory of Loki
Kang variant visibly in control of the TVA

chunks.text:
Loki: I am Loki of Asgard, and I am burdened with glorious purpose.
Mobius: Yeah, about that... we've got a lot of paperwork to go through, and glory isn't high on the priority list. You know, I've got a whole drawer full of those titles. Do you know what this place is?

Loki: The Infinity Stones... how do you have these?
Casey: Oh, we actually get a lot of those. Some of the guys use them as paperweights. Is it a big deal? What are they?
Loki: It's the greatest power in the universe. Is this... is this the greatest power in the universe?

Long ago, there was a vast Multiversal War. Countless unique timelines battled each other for supremacy, nearly resulting in the total destruction of everything. Then, the all-knowing Time-Keepers emerged, bringing peace by reorganizing the multiverse into a single, cohesive timeline: the Sacred Timeline. The Time Variance Authority manages and monitors the flow of time so that history conforms to the Time-Keepers' grand plan.

Mobius: You don't enjoy hurting people. It's an act. It's a clever trick played by the boy who shivered in the shadow of his brother. You weren't born to be king, Loki. You were born to cause pain and suffering and death. That's how it is, that's how it was, that's how it will be. All so that others can achieve their best versions of themselves.

Mobius: You think you're the only one who can outsmart fate?
Loki: No one bad is ever truly bad, and no one good is ever truly good.
Mobius: Look at you, philosopher king. Now tell me how she's hiding from us.

Loki's breakthrough theory establishes that an apocalyptic event completely hides temporal variance. Because everything and everyone in an apocalypse is scheduled for imminent total destruction, whatever a variant does beforehand cannot ripple forward into the future timeline. In Pompeii in 79 AD, Loki proves this to Mobius by setting bird cages open and shouting in Latin; zero variance is registered on the TemPad.

Loki: What do you want? Who are you?
Sylvie: Brutus, don't ask questions you're not ready to hear the answers to.
Loki: I'm not who you think I am. We could overthrow the Time-Keepers together.
Sylvie: This isn't about you.

At the Roxxcart Haven Hills mega-store during the 2050 hurricane, Sylvie deploys dozens of reset charges attached to timed transport conduits. At the designated second, all charges activate simultaneously, teleporting to vital timeline moments throughout history (e.g. Rome 154 AD, Ego 1382, Vormir 2301, Asgard 2004). This massive attack creates thousands of simultaneous branching realities, overwhelming TVA monitors.

Sylvie: What does love mean to a prince of Asgard?
Loki: Love is a dagger. It's a weapon to be wielded far away or up close. You can see yourself in it. It's beautiful until it makes you bleed. But ultimately, when you reach for it...
Sylvie: It isn't real. Love is an imaginary dagger.
Loki: Terrible metaphor, I know.

On the passenger train to Shur-god, Sylvie reveals the truth behind the TVA's workforce: the Time-Keepers did not create them from scratch. Every Minuteman, Hunter, and Analyst is a regular human variant kidnapped from a pruned timeline whose memories were wiped. Hunter C-20, whom Sylvie enchanted, remembered drinking margarita cocktails with friends in a bar on Earth.

Loki drinks champagne in the passenger car, wearing his ceremonial uniform and singing 'Jeg saler min hest' in Old Norse while dancing on dining tables. After finishing his goblet, he yells 'Another!' and smashes the glass against the floor in traditional Asgardian fashion, drawing the attention of the guards and blowing their cover.

Lady Sif: You narcissistic, arrogant pig! You cut my hair!
Loki: Sif, please, it'll grow back!
Lady Sif: You're going to die alone, Loki. You will always be alone.
Mobius leaves Loki in the TVA memory cell loop where Sif continually knees him in the groin and punches him across the room on an infinite temporal loop.

TVA monitors track an unprecedented event: a Nexus branch expanding straight up towards the redline on a dying moon where no branch should be possible. The emotional connection between Loki and Sylvie—two variants of the exact same being falling in love—shatters deterministic probability, allowing Mobius and Hunter B-15 to locate and rescue them seconds before Lamentis-1's planetary collision.

Mobius: You can be whatever you want to be. Even someone good. I believe you now.
Ravonna Renslayer: Prune him.
Mobius: Wait, Ravonna—
A Minuteman touches Mobius with a Prune Stick, dissolving him into orange temporal ribbons as Ravonna coldly watches, cementing her defense of the Time-Keepers' lies.

In the golden throne room, Sylvie decapitates the central Time-Keeper. The head lands on the dais, laughing mechanically with sparking wiring and robotic gears exposed.
Sylvie: Fake. Mindless androids. It's all a lie.
Loki: Who created them? Who's running the TVA?
Before Loki can confess his feelings to Sylvie, Ravonna strikes him from behind with a Prune Stick.

Loki: How did you survive Thanos?
Classic Loki: Blades? Sorcery is our gift. I cast a projection of myself so real, even the Mad Titan was fooled. Then I drifted in space as inanimate debris. I found a remote planet at the edge of the cosmos and stayed there in complete solitude for centuries. But we are Gods of Mischief. I missed my brother. The second I stepped off the planet, the TVA stepped in.

The Void is a desolate realm at the very end of time where the TVA deposits pruned matter, branches, and variants. Nothing can grow or escape because the Void is inhabited by Alioth, a massive living tempest that consumes entire timelines and matter instantly. Living in the Void means continually running from Alioth.

As Alioth bears down on Loki and Sylvie, Classic Loki plants his feet and summons all his magical might. Golden beams shoot into the dark sky, conjuring a full, towering illusion of the city of Asgard in breathtaking detail. Classic Loki cackles with pure joy: 'Glorious purpose!' as Alioth consumes the projection and swallows him whole, leaving only his golden horned helmet behind.

President Loki: Let's not make this difficult. Hand over the boy and we won't have to hurt you.
Kid Loki: You're in my bowling alley now, idiot.
President Loki tries to posture, but Alligator Loki lunges forward and clamps his jaws onto President Loki's right hand, biting it clean off at the wrist, sparking a chaotic all-out brawl among thirty Loki variants.

He Who Remains: You kill me, and you open up the timeline to an infinite number of me, none of whom are as polite or diplomatic. They will conquer, enslave, and wage war across the multiverse until everything burns.
Sylvie: You're a liar and a monster.
Loki: Sylvie, wait! I've been where you are. I've felt what you feel. I don't want a throne. I just want you to be okay.

He Who Remains explains the origin of the TVA and Multiversal War: In the 31st century on Earth, a scientist variant discovered that universes were stacked on top of each other. At first, other variants shared knowledge and technology. But soon, darker variants viewed new realities solely as lands to conquer, sparking an all-out Multiversal War. He Who Remains weaponized Alioth, the beast formed from the tears in reality, to eradicate his variants and establish a single pruned timeline.

Sylvie kisses Loki passionately, then activates a TemPad behind his back and pushes him through the timedoor back to the TVA. She turns to He Who Remains, who sits calmly on his desk.
Sylvie plunges her dagger into his heart.
He Who Remains chuckles quietly, winks at her, and whispers: 'See you soon.' He slumps forward as outside, the Sacred Timeline begins branching uncontrollably into a kaleidoscopic web.

Loki sprints into the TVA library and spots Mobius and Hunter B-15 studying timeline branch projections.
Loki: We made a terrible mistake! Someone is coming, countless variants of him!
Mobius: Calm down, take a breath. What division are you from? Who are you?
Loki looks around in horror and sees a giant bronze statue of Kang / He Who Remains standing in the center of the TVA where the Time-Keepers' monuments once stood.

The TemPad is the standard pocket-sized device utilized by TVA personnel to manipulate time and space. It enables users to open glowing yellow-orange timedoor portals to any coordinate along the Sacred Timeline, scan historical periods for Nexus branch deviation percentages, and review temporal telemetry. TemPads run on specialized batteries that require substantial recharge power.

Reset Charges are cylindrical explosive devices deployed by TVA Minutemen at the nexus epicenter of an unauthorized branch. When activated, the charge emits an expanding dome of blue temporal energy that disintegrates and prunes all altered matter and timeline branches, healing the timeline back to the predetermined parameters of the Sacred Timeline.

A Nexus Event occurs whenever a conscious being deviates from the actions preordained by the Sacred Timeline (such as Loki escaping custody or arriving late to work). This initiates a new timeline branch. If left unchecked past the redline threshold, the branch stabilizes into an irreversible alternate universe, risking temporal collisions and multiversal war.

The Citadel at the End of Time sits perched on a floating crystalline asteroid at the terminus of all reality. Carved with classical gothic arches repaired with kintsugi-style gold veins, the Citadel is protected from intruders by the living storm Alioth. Inside, He Who Remains monitors the complete, unbroken ring of the Sacred Timeline circling his castle.

Judge Ravonna Renslayer rose through the ranks of the TVA after beginning her career as Minuteman Hunter A-20. On a mission to Asgard, Renslayer arrested child Sylvie. In the present day, Renslayer presides over trials and is the sole liaison to the Time-Keepers. Her human variant was Rebecca Tourminet, a high school vice principal in 2018 Franklin, Ohio.

Mobius M. Mobius is a TVA investigator known for his patience and belief that variants can be redeemed. He harbors a deep fascination with 1990s Earth culture, particularly personal watercraft (jet skis), which he considers a majestic symbol of human recreation. Before his memory was wiped by the TVA, his true variant identity was Don, a single father in Palo Alto, California, who sold jet skis.

Sylvie is a female variant of Loki from a branch of Asgard where she was born a girl. As a young child playing with miniature valkyrie toys in the royal throne room, she was arrested by Hunter A-20 without knowing what her Nexus Event was. She bit her guard, stole a TemPad, and grew up on the run across history, sleeping in volcanic eruptions, floods, and comets.
